intro.title: Why I'm Here
intro.text:
Poetry teaches us to choose every word with devotion and care, and invites us to listen to them with tenderness and awe. In this simple act, we find the purest foundation of love.

This is my space to express myself as I’ve fallen in love with poetry.

It’s a form of therapy. It gives me breath while taking my breath away.
It’s where my love lives. It’s where I can be understood. It’s where I grow.

My Infinite Adore, when your heart is ready, you’ll know where to find me.

originals.title: My Infinite Adore
originals.text:
My Infinite Adore
I lay each stone in silence
a dwelling untouched
For when your heart remembers
our unwritten pages
The walls will wake
to whisper the version of us
time was too young to hold

originals.title: Rubberband
originals.text:
I got this rubberband on my wrist
and i snap it every time that i think about your lips
I got this rubberband on my wrist
almost break it every time that i’m trying to forget
I got this rubberband on my wrist
and i snap it every time to remember you exist
I got this rubberband on my wrist
and I break it every time I remember the promise I still haven’t kept yet

originals.title: Through your eyes
originals.text:
Do you still see the ghost I used to be?
Or do I wear his shadow on my skin?
Am I forever tethered to his memory?
Or can you see where I begin?

I’ve shed the past like borrowed sin,
do you still mistake the ashes for the flame?
As I rise, untouched by him,
will I be someone you love again?

originals.title: Grilled Cheese
originals.text:
I’m Noah, eyes always wet, waiting for the door to open.
But the house I’m building isn’t wood or paint.
It’s the four walls, the roof, and the door of my heart.
Untouched by the scars.

And the soft breath I’m left with in your absence,
barely enough to keep me alive,
feeds the light on the front porch.

So when that knob finally turns,
you can sit at the table,
and I’ll make you a grilled cheese.
